name: XI · Justice
title: VIII · Adjustment
imagery: A slender masked woman balances on tiptoe within a diamond of light, holding a great sword point down between her knees. Scales hang from her headdress, weighing alpha and omega. Everything is poised in perfect, delicate equilibrium.
meaning: Adjustment is the constant correction that keeps the universe in balance. It is less about judgment and more about restoring equilibrium. Every action meets its response. Make the adjustments that bring your life back into harmony.
affirmation: I make the adjustments that restore balance.

ctx.past: Past actions have come into balance.
ctx.present: Adjust what is out of alignment.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be unexamined karma.

name: XII · The Hanged Man
title: XII · The Hanged Man
imagery: A man hangs upside down from an ankh, nailed at his hands and foot, his body forming a cross over a triangle. Green squares form a grid behind him, and serpents coil at the top and bottom.
meaning: The Thoth Hanged Man is surrender and sacrifice. Old patterns must be released, even if it feels like a loss. Stillness and letting go lead to transformation.
affirmation: I surrender what I no longer need.

ctx.future: A period of surrender is coming.

name: XIII · Death
title: XIII · Death
imagery: A skeleton wearing a crown swings a scythe, and bubbles rise from its blade carrying new forms of life. A scorpion, a snake and a fish appear below, and an eagle soars above. Dark greens and blues swirl around him.
meaning: Death in the Thoth deck is the dance of transformation. Endings create new beginnings. Let go and allow the change.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of loss.

name: XIV · Temperance
title: XIV · Art
imagery: A double-faced figure stirs a cauldron, pouring fire from one hand and water from the other. A lion and an eagle have swapped their usual colors. Behind the figure, a golden arc carries a Latin phrase about seeking the hidden stone.
meaning: Art is alchemy: blending opposites to create something greater. It speaks of creativity, integration and transformation. Combine the elements of your life into something new.
affirmation: I blend opposites into something greater.

ctx.present: Blend different parts of your life.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be inner conflict.

name: XV · The Devil
title: XV · The Devil
imagery: A goat with great spiral horns and a third eye stands smiling before a vast phallic tree. A winged wand rises beside him, and figures press within the roots below. The mood is earthy, wild and humorous.
meaning: The Thoth Devil is raw creative energy and earthly ambition. It can bind or empower. Use your drive and desire wisely, without becoming enslaved by them.
numerology: Fifteen reduces to six, testing choice.
affirmation: I direct my desires with awareness.

ctx.past: Ambition or desire drove your past.
ctx.present: Raw energy is available. Direct it.
ctx.spirit: Your guides ask you to own your shadow.
ctx.shadow: This card is the shadow's raw power.

name: XVI · The Tower
title: XVI · The Tower
imagery: A great eye stares from above as flames burst from the jaws of a monstrous mouth at the base of a tower. Geometric figures fall from it, and a dove and a serpent appear in the sky. Everything is fractured and fiery.
meaning: The Thoth Tower is sudden destruction that clears the way for truth. It is shocking but purifying. Let the false fall away.
affirmation: I welcome the truth that sets me free.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be suppressed anger.

name: XVII · The Star
title: XVII · The Star
imagery: A star goddess pours water from a golden cup and a silver cup, the streams spiraling into space. A great spiral star shines above, and a celestial globe hangs nearby. Blue light fills the scene.
meaning: The Thoth Star is hope and cosmic inspiration. You are connected to the stars and guided by a higher purpose. Trust and follow your vision.

name: XVIII · The Moon
title: XVIII · The Moon
imagery: Two dark towers flank a path running between them toward a dim moon. Jackal-headed guardians stand at the gate, and a scarab beetle rises from the water below, carrying a sun. The colors are deep violet and blue.
meaning: The Thoth Moon is the dark threshold of the unconscious, full of illusion and fear. Walk through carefully, trusting that the sun will rise.
affirmation: I walk through the darkness toward the dawn.

ctx.future: A period of mystery is coming.
ctx.shadow: This card is the realm of shadow.

name: XIX · The Sun
title: XIX · The Sun
imagery: Two winged children dance joyfully on a green mound beneath a radiant sun, which is framed by a rose and circled by the signs of the zodiac. A wall surrounds the mound.
meaning: The Thoth Sun is joy, freedom and radiant success. Life is bright and full. Celebrate and shine.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of joy.

name: XX · Judgement
title: XX · The Aeon
imagery: A star goddess arches over the whole card, her body forming the sky. A winged globe glows in the center, and a child figure sits within a field of light, finger raised to its lips. The scene announces the start of a new age.
meaning: The Aeon marks a new era. Old ways are ending and a new consciousness is being born. Embrace the future and step into it.
affirmation: I step boldly into a new era.

ctx.spirit: Your guides announce a new age.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of change.

name: XXI · The World
title: XXI · The Universe
imagery: A dancing woman holds a sickle and plays with a great serpent, framed by an elliptical ring of stars. The four creatures watch from the corners, and a geometric structure of the universe forms the background.
meaning: The Universe is completion and cosmic wholeness. Everything has come together. Celebrate fulfillment and prepare for what comes next.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of endings.
